title: Dataplex Universal Catalog integration for Data Transfers
summary: BigQuery Data Transfer Service now supports automated metadata import into Dataplex Universal Catalog during data transfers.
details: A new `metadataDestination` field has been added to both `TransferConfig` and `TransferRun` resources. This field utilizes the newly introduced `DataplexConfiguration` schema, allowing developers to specify a Dataplex `entryGroup` (formatted as `projects/{project_id}/locations/{region}/entryGroups/{entry_group_id}`) where transfer metadata should be cataloged. This effectively bridges the gap between data movement and data governance within the GCP ecosystem.
